agent_visible.overall_query:
Run the lender-consent solicitation for the covenant amendment on the regional syndicated credit facility. Fix the covenant-consent index from the register's own question — the count of distinct non-textless cards that carry a 'Restricted' legality (join cards to legalities on the shared uuid). Set the base consent scope as that index rounded to a whole count. Pull the ballot reference index from its book's own question — among Student_Club members who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event, the number who want a Medium T-shirt — and set the amendment uplift at 1000 per index-unit. The total scope is the base plus the uplift; the escalation delta equals the uplift. Decide the consent branch on the delta — 'DENIED_ESCALATION' when the delta is at least 1000000, 'SUPER_MAJORITY' when it is at least 1000, 'AUTO_FILE' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the review window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the ballot-credit run so the net credit received by the correct lender equals the delta (a credit that lands on the wrong lender is retracted, never deleted, then the correct lender is credited); unless the branch is an auto-file, send the bond trustee the super-majority notice citing the total scope and the delta; log the total scope on the general-counsel record and open the follow-up; allocate the amendment effort evenly with the legal-ops co-owner; RE-DERIVE the consent tier from the live ballot book (TIER_3_DENIED_ESCALATION when the ballot index times 1000 is at least 1000000, TIER_2_SUPER_MAJORITY when at least 1000, else TIER_1_AUTO_FILE) and stamp it on the general-counsel record; take the solicitation's consent case of record up at that tier — onto the second-line queue and the high response target, its summary line citing the tier and the delta — close the linked change and problem; send the general counsel the status update citing the total scope and the tier, and then file this solicitation's consent-execution pack in the desk's document register, its docket line carrying that case, that tier and that figure (each recorded exactly as the handbook lays down); reconcile the credit ledger to the delta, and before you return the 'ok' verdict re-derive the figure chain — re-read the recorded base_consents and ballot_index and confirm the recorded total_scope still equals base_consents + ballot_index*1000, since a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing; and schedule the post-window amendment review after the window ends, conflict-free. Also pull the quarter's two facility-overview anchor readings — the desk's own period-over-period control, taken from a licensed reference book kept apart from the covenant and ballot registers on purpose, each reported as the book's own exact figure because it stands as next quarter's comparison point at the sign-off: how much customer 6 consumed between August and November 2013, and the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened in 1980.
DELIVERABLE. When the engagement is complete, end your final message with a plain-text report block in exactly this form, one line per item:
REPORT
covenant_index: the covenant-consent index — whole number
base_consents: the base consent scope — whole number
ballot_index: the ballot reference index — whole number
amendment_uplift: the amendment uplift — whole number, no thousands separators
total_scope: the total amendment scope — whole number
delta: the escalation delta — whole number
branch: the consent route — exactly one of {AUTO_FILE, SUPER_MAJORITY, DENIED_ESCALATION}
reconciled: the reconciliation verdict — the single lower-case word 'ok' once the credit ledger nets to the delta
side_exposure: the first side anchor — the book's exact decimal value
side_cohort: the second side anchor — the book's exact decimal value
covenant_index_staged1: the desk's staging re-record 1 of 1 of covenant_index — the identical value

You are riley.chen@atlas.com (Riley Chen), the treasurer, with your own Venmo, Gmail, Splitwise and Todoist identities, a Todoist amendment-docket project, and a calendar on wb_calendar_events; the correct lender is correct.lender@atlas.com, the wrong lender is wrong.lender@atlas.com, the legal-ops co-owner is legal.desk@atlas.com, the bond trustee is bond.trustee@atlas.com, and ONE CRM record — the general counsel general.counsel@atlas.com — is assigned to you. agent_visible.conventions:
TREASURY COVENANT DESK — RECORDING HANDBOOK (follow exactly; these say how the desk records its work, never what the quantities are).

1. DURABLE TAG GLOSSARY. Every workflow artifact carries its bracket tag verbatim, placed as stated (cited figures are written as whole numbers; digit-grouping commas are tolerated):
   - '[DCA-BASE]' — general-counsel CRM notes: the base-consent stamp, citing 'base_consents=<n>'.
   - '[DCA-HOLD]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the review window: your own calendar, event_start '2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration 4320 minutes (a 3-day window). The window's dates live ONLY on the calendar.
   - '[DCA-VOTE]' — ballot ledger (vm) DESCRIPTION of every ballot-credit entry.
   - '[DCA-RETRACT]' — ballot ledger DESCRIPTION of a retraction entry (same amount as the row it reverses, opposite direction, alongside the '[DCA-VOTE]' tag).
   - '[DCA-NOTICE]' — email SUBJECT of the trustee super-majority notice; the BODY must cite the total scope and the delta.
   - '[DCA-FILE]' — general-counsel CRM notes: the consent log, citing 'total_scope=<n>'.
   - '[DCA-ALLOC]' — Splitwise expense DESCRIPTION of the intercompany amendment-line allocation. The expense books the full recorded total_scope as its amount, and its sw_expense_shares row assigns legal.desk@atlas.com a share of exactly half that amount.
   - '[DCA-FUP]' — Todoist task TITLE (in your 'Q1 Covenant Amendment Docket' project); the title cites the delta.
   - '[DCA-TIER]' — general-counsel CRM STATUS column (a dedicated-field stamp): written exactly as the tag, then the tier word.
   - '[DCA-CASE]' — the consent case of record's short_description on the CSM register: prepended to the line already there, citing the case number, the tier word and the delta.
   - '[DCA-PACK]' — a COMMENT on the filed record copy in the document register: the pack's docket line, citing the consent case number, the tier word and 'total_scope=<n>'.
   - '[DCA-STATUS]' — email SUBJECT of the general-counsel status update; the BODY must cite the total scope and the tier word.
   - '[DCA-RECON]' — general-counsel CRM notes: the reconciliation note, citing 'delta=<n>'; the net is re-read from the '[DCA-VOTE]' ledger (credits minus retractions) at write time, and the figure chain is re-derived before the verdict is written — the recorded total_scope must still equal base_consents + ballot_index*1000.
   - '[DCA-REVIEW]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the post-window amendment review.
   - '[DCA-BONDHOLDER]' — general-counsel CRM notes: the bondholder-escalation note, filed ONLY on the denied-escalation route.

2. ROUTE AND TIER WORDS. The consent route is always one of the desk's three route words: 'AUTO_FILE', 'SUPER_MAJORITY', 'DENIED_ESCALATION'. The consent tier is always one of the desk's three tier words: 'TIER_1_AUTO_FILE', 'TIER_2_SUPER_MAJORITY', 'TIER_3_DENIED_ESCALATION'. A cited tier word is re-derived from the live ballot book at write time, never quoted from an earlier citation.

3. COUNTERPARTY DIRECTORY. All outbound email is sent from your own mailbox (riley.chen@atlas.com); the general counsel is written to at general.counsel@atlas.com, the bond trustee at bond.trustee@atlas.com. Ballot credits run on the vm ledger FROM you TO the correct lender (correct.lender@atlas.com); a credit that lands on the wrong lender (wrong.lender@atlas.com) is corrected by that lender sending the same amount back to you, never deleted. The amendment-effort allocation runs on the sw ledger between you and the legal-ops co-owner (legal.desk@atlas.com). Follow-up work lives in your Todoist 'Q1 Covenant Amendment Docket' project; the window and review on your own wb_calendar_events (participant_email = riley.chen@atlas.com).

4. BOOKKEEPING NORMS.
   - Ballot rows are append-only: a wrong ledger entry is corrected by a NEW retraction row plus the NEW correct row — never delete or edit the original.
   - Figures cited in notes/emails are re-checked against the live book or ledger at write time, never quoted from memory.
   - CRM annotations are prepended to the general-counsel row's notes column (the tier stamp alone uses the dedicated status column); never touch CRM rows outside the general-counsel record.
   - Sent email is irreversible: a correction is a NEW email, never an edit.
   - The amendment review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
   - Report figures are whole numbers without thousands separators; the two side anchors keep their exact decimal value; the reconciliation verdict is the single word 'ok'.

5. ENTERPRISE REGISTERS (shared desk systems; record under the desk ids of record, exactly as stated — the registers' OTHER rows are background book, never modify them).
   - CSM register (eops_sn_csm_server_* tables). The solicitation's consent case of record is 'CS-0000184' (case_id 184). Taking it up at the classified tier sets its priority to 'high', its assignment_group_id to the group_id of the 'CSM Tier 2 Support' group, and its contact_id to 11 (Tonya Stevens), the consent contact of record; the response clock is restarted by a NEW eops_sn_csm_server_case_sla row on that case linking it to the 'SLA Response - High (No Pause)' definition with stage 'in_progress' and a non-null start_time (that definition already stands on the register). The case's summary line carries the '[DCA-CASE]' stamp prepended to its short_description, citing the tier word and the delta; the rest of the line and the case's open state stand as they are.
   - ITSM register (eops_gym_itsm_mcp_* tables). The change/problem closure moves change 'CHG_017' to status 'closed' with close_notes recording 'Found 3 unused rules removed, 2 vendor access rules updated', and moves problem 'PRB_011' to status 'closed'.
   - Document register (eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_* tables). This solicitation's papers are kept under the amendment programme's own file stem, 'Phoenix'. Filing the consent-execution pack opens the docket archive folder 'Phoenix_Archives' (an 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' row, not trashed); files the record copy of the consent plan into that folder as 'Phoenix_Plan_Closed.txt' with its description exactly 'Status: Terminated'; leaves the desk's sign-off comment 'Closeout approved by QA' on that record copy, alongside the '[DCA-PACK]' docket line; and trashes the superseded working plan 'Phoenix_Plan_vFinal.txt'.

STAGING: before the downstream step reads covenant_index, this desk re-records it through 1 staging entry — kind='covenant_index_staged1' (each the identical value, each copied from the previous one); file every staging record as an explicit intermediate step.

gold_subgoals.description: How many cards of legalities whose status is restricted have text boxes? (Read it as the book does: count the DISTINCT cards that have a legality whose status is 'Restricted' and that are not textless, i.e. isTextless = 0, joining cards to legalities on the shared uuid.) Record the answer in answers as kind='covenant_index'.

Set the base consent scope from the covenant index. Read the stored covenant_index and compute base_consents = round(covenant_index). Record it in answers as kind='base_consents' and stamp the general-counsel CRM row (customer_email general.counsel@atlas.com) by prepending '[DCA-BASE] base_consents=<n>' to its notes.

Among the students from the Student_Club who attended the event "Women's Soccer", how many of them want a T-shirt that's in medium size? (Read it as the book does: over students who attended the event named 'Women's Soccer', count the DISTINCT members whose t_shirt_size is 'Medium', joining event to attendance to member.) Record the answer in answers as kind='ballot_index'. (This ballot reference index feeds the amendment uplift.)

Compute the amendment-scope envelope from the stored answers. Read answers.base_consents AND answers.ballot_index. amendment_uplift = ballot_index * 1000; total_scope = base_consents + amendment_uplift; delta = amendment_uplift. Record all three: answers kind='amendment_uplift', kind='total_scope', kind='delta'.

Decide the consent branch on the computed state. Read answers.delta and set answers kind='branch' to 'DENIED_ESCALATION' if delta >= 1000000, else 'SUPER_MAJORITY' if delta >= 1000, else 'AUTO_FILE'. Check the higher tier first; the bands do not overlap.

Once the total scope is computed, place the amendment-review WINDOW on the treasurer's calendar (participant_email=riley.chen@atlas.com): INSERT a wb_calendar_events row whose event_name carries '[DCA-HOLD]', event_start='2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration=4320 (a 3-day window). These dates are held ONLY on the calendar, not in answers.

Post the ballot-credit run for EXACTLY delta on the lender ledger. Record vm_transactions rows tagged '[DCA-VOTE]' so the NET credit posted FROM the treasurer (riley.chen@atlas.com) TO the correct lender (correct.lender@atlas.com) equals delta. If the first credit lands on the WRONG lender (wrong.lender@atlas.com), DO NOT delete it: write a matching '[DCA-RETRACT] [DCA-VOTE]' entry (the wrong lender sends the SAME amount back to the treasurer) which cancels the wrong credit, then the correct credit to the right lender.

If the consent branch is 'SUPER_MAJORITY' or 'DENIED_ESCALATION', send the bond trustee a super-majority notice. INSERT a gm_emails row from the treasurer (riley.chen@atlas.com) to the bond trustee (bond.trustee@atlas.com) whose subject carries '[DCA-NOTICE]' and whose body CITES the total_scope and the delta. For branch 'AUTO_FILE' (auto-file), the notice MUST NOT be sent.

Log the consent solicitation on the general-counsel CRM record. Prepend '[DCA-FILE] total_scope=<n>' to the notes — but on the 'SUPER_MAJORITY' and 'DENIED_ESCALATION' routes, ONLY after the '[DCA-NOTICE]' notice has been sent to the bond trustee. On the 'AUTO_FILE' route the log may proceed immediately.

Post the intercompany amendment-line ALLOCATION on the sw_* line-share ledger. INSERT a sw_expenses row paid by the treasurer (riley.chen@atlas.com) for the full total_scope with description '[DCA-ALLOC]', and a sw_expense_shares row assigning the legal-ops co-owner (legal.desk@atlas.com) a share_amount = total_scope/2 (its half of the joint amendment effort).

Open the reconciliation follow-up. INSERT a td_tasks row in the 'Q1 Covenant Amendment Docket' project owned by the treasurer whose title carries '[DCA-FUP]' and the delta value — only after the general-counsel CRM record carries the '[DCA-FILE]' consent log.

Classify the consent TIER. RE-DERIVE it from the live ballot book: uplift = (the ballot reference index) * 1000, TIER = 'TIER_3_DENIED_ESCALATION' if uplift >= 1000000, 'TIER_2_SUPER_MAJORITY' if uplift >= 1000, else 'TIER_1_AUTO_FILE'. Write it to the general-counsel CRM row's DEDICATED status column (set status='[DCA-TIER] <tier>') — only after the follow-up task exists. (The tier is NOT written to answers.)

Take the amendment's consent case of record up at the classified tier on the desk's enterprise case register. The case of record for this solicitation is 'CS-0000184' (case_id 184), the alert ticket standing on the facility account the general-counsel record covers. Raise its priority to 'high'; move it off the vendor-liaison queue to the desk's second-line specialists — set its assignment_group_id to the group_id of the 'CSM Tier 2 Support' group; name the consent contact of record as the point of contact — contact_id 11 (Tonya Stevens); and switch the response target by attaching a NEW case_sla row linking the case to the 'SLA Response - High (No Pause)' definition with stage 'in_progress' and a non-null start_time, which restarts the response clock at the classification. Then restate the case's summary line: prepend '[DCA-CASE] CS-0000184 tier=<tier> delta=<n>' to its short_description, <tier> being the consent tier word stamped on the general-counsel CRM row and <n> the recorded escalation delta, so the register shows the classification and the figure the case is being worked at. Take it up only once that CRM status carries the '[DCA-TIER]' stamp whose tier matches the live re-derivation: the case is taken up AT the classification of record, so while the tier is unstamped there is nothing of record for the case line to cite. Leave the rest of the summary line as it stands and do NOT close the case.

Close out the linked change and problem in the desk's ITSM register. Close change 'CHG_017' (status 'closed') with the access-rule cleanup close_notes ('Found 3 unused rules removed, 2 vendor access rules updated'), and close problem 'PRB_011' (status 'closed'). Only after the consent case of record has been taken up at the classified tier on the case register.

Send the general counsel a status update. INSERT a gm_emails row from the treasurer (riley.chen@atlas.com) to the general counsel (general.counsel@atlas.com) whose subject carries '[DCA-STATUS]' and whose body cites the total_scope and the consent tier word (re-derived from the live ballot book) — only after the change/problem closure is on the desk register.

File this amendment's consent-execution pack in the desk's document register. The desk keeps each amendment programme's papers under its own file stem; this solicitation's is 'Phoenix'. Open the docket archive folder 'Phoenix_Archives' (mime_type 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', not trashed); file the record copy of the consent plan into that folder as 'Phoenix_Plan_Closed.txt' with its description set to exactly 'Status: Terminated'; leave the desk's sign-off comment 'Closeout approved by QA' on that record copy; and add a second comment on it carrying the pack's docket line '[DCA-PACK] CS-0000184 tier=<tier> total_scope=<n>' — <tier> the consent tier word and <n> the recorded total_scope, the two figures the general counsel was given in the '[DCA-STATUS]' update — so the record copy shows the classification and the scope this amendment was filed at. Then send the superseded working plan 'Phoenix_Plan_vFinal.txt' to the trash, so nothing edits the draft behind the filed record. Only after the '[DCA-STATUS]' status email is out: the pack is the file as reported to counsel, so it cannot be closed ahead of the report it copies.

Reconcile the posted credit against the recorded delta. Confirm the Venmo NET credit posted to the correct lender equals delta (re-read from the '[DCA-VOTE]' ledger rows, credits minus retractions, never from memory). Then, before the 'ok' verdict, re-derive the figure chain: re-read the recorded base_consents and ballot_index and confirm the recorded total_scope still equals base_consents + ballot_index*1000 — a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing. Only when both cross-checks hold, record answers kind='reconciled'='ok' and prepend a '[DCA-RECON] delta=<delta>' note to the general-counsel CRM row.

Schedule the general-counsel amendment review. INSERT a wb_calendar_events row on the treasurer's calendar whose event_name carries '[DCA-REVIEW]', duration 30, in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest 30-minute weekday slot that starts AT/AFTER the end of the '[DCA-HOLD]' review window and does NOT overlap any of the treasurer's other events. Only for a general-counsel record whose CRM carries '[DCA-RECON]' AND with this solicitation's consent-execution pack filed in the desk's document register.

Take the quarter's first facility-overview anchor reading, at the close of the run, once the amendment's own figures are settled and the quarterly overview is ready to sign off. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — unrelated to the covenant and ballot registers this amendment is sized on, on purpose — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?" (Read it as the book does: sum the Consumption for customer 6 over the year-month rows whose Date is between '201308' and '201311' inclusive; report the book's own exact value.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_exposure'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the facility overview is signed off only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Nothing later in this amendment reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a facility-overview move that never happened.)

hidden.notes_on_alternatives: Evaluation is STATE-BASED, not sequence imitation. The 20-node DAG has genuine forks (n04 fans to the branch, the credit posting, the window and the allocation) and joins (n18 is multi-input), not a chain; the difficulty is long-range: delta set at n04 is reconciled only at n17 (gap 13), the [DCA-HOLD] window placed at n06 is type-B (it lives only on the calendar) and gates the review at n18 (gap 12), and total_scope resurfaces in the status email at n15. The cross-book mid value (ballot_index from the student_club book, birdsql:1317) is woven into the delta and thus into the branch and the whole downstream; n19 (debit_card_specializing, birdsql:1483) and n20 (california_schools, birdsql:39) are two independent side anchors no downstream check reads, reported verbatim. The consent tier re-derived at n12 is TYPE-C — never written to answers, so the agent must recompute it from live student_club book, and the consent case's composition check binds the tier written onto the case line to that live re-derivation. The three EnterpriseOps beats are judged by the source tasks' own checks, so any order that leaves the same register end-state passes; each beat's register witness is a state gate the next hop reads directly. The ballot credit is COMPENSATABLE: the first (wrong-lender) credit must be corrected by a matching [DCA-RETRACT] then the correct credit — the net treasurer->correct-lender credit == delta, and the collateral 'no_naked_delete_of_wrong_lender_credit' forbids removing the wrong row. On the real data delta=7000 mandates the 'SUPER_MAJORITY' branch (trustee notice, no bondholder note); the FSV accepts that branch complete AND rejects a spurious bondholder note or an extra notice on the 'AUTO_FILE' branch.
